Hyaluronic Acid.intro: A naturally occurring molecule valued for its ability to retain water and support skin comfort.
Hyaluronic Acid.origin: Hyaluronic acid is naturally present in animal and human tissues, including the skin, joints and connective tissues. In cosmetic and veterinary care, it can be obtained through biofermentation.
Hyaluronic Acid.benefits: It helps maintain hydration, suppleness and skin elasticity, making it useful in formulas created for fragile, dry or uncomfortable skin.
Hyaluronic Acid.care: Used by Biogance in targeted care formulas where hydration, skin comfort and suppleness are key.

Garlic.intro: A traditional botanical ingredient selected for fortifying care and its long history of use in plant-based preparations.
Garlic.origin: Garlic is a bulbous plant originating from Central Asia. It has been cultivated for thousands of years and is now grown around the world.
Garlic.benefits: Its naturally occurring compounds make it an ingredient used in fortifying formulas, particularly those focused on coat condition and vitality.
Garlic.care: Biogance uses garlic in targeted coat-care formulas, including products designed to support the appearance of healthy hair.

Aloe Vera.intro: One of Biogance's signature botanical ingredients, chosen for skin comfort, hydration and coat softness.
Aloe Vera.origin: Aloe vera is a succulent plant associated with warm, dry climates and has a long history of cosmetic use.
Aloe Vera.benefits: It is widely used in pet-care formulas for hydration and comfort, while helping leave the coat soft, smooth and easier to manage.
Aloe Vera.care: Aloe vera appears across several Biogance care ranges, including formulas for coat care and sensitive skin.

Sweet Almond.intro: A nourishing ingredient traditionally used to bring softness and comfort to dry skin and coats.
Sweet Almond.origin: Sweet almond comes from the almond tree, historically cultivated around the Mediterranean and in warm, dry regions.
Sweet Almond.benefits: Its emollient profile makes it especially suitable for nourishing care, helping improve softness and the appearance of dry or dull coats.
Sweet Almond.care: Used in conditioning and grooming formulas where nourishment, detangling and softness are key.

Marine Mud.intro: A mineral-rich marine ingredient selected for purifying and comfort-focused care.
Marine Mud.origin: Marine mud is collected from mineral- and organic-rich marine or coastal sediments.
Marine Mud.benefits: It is traditionally valued for its mineral content and is used in formulas designed to purify, tone and bring comfort to the skin.
Marine Mud.care: A natural choice for spa-inspired and targeted skin-care rituals.

Chamomile.intro: A gentle botanical associated with soothing care and delicate routines.
Chamomile.origin: Roman chamomile is a herbaceous plant traditionally found across parts of Western Europe and North Africa.
Chamomile.benefits: Its gentle profile makes it a natural fit for formulas designed for sensitive or delicate care routines.
Chamomile.care: Used in soft cleansing and grooming formulas, particularly where comfort is a priority.
